quotations:
Deepseek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is available now through the company's website, app, and API. Deepseek also published the model weights as open source on
Hugging Face
and
ModelScope
. Compared to its direct predecessor, the model posts better benchmark scores, finishes tasks faster, and produces shorter outputs. The company calls the update a Pareto improvement in the tradeoff between performance and cost.

Each endpoint costs $0.75 per 1,000 calls. Deepseek API users can access the features for free through server-side tools in Deepseek Harness, Claude Code, and Codex until October 31, 2026 (4:00 PM UTC).
